ED DEATH NOTE 11/03/2076 Saint Aldric Regional Medical Center Emergency Dept Pt: Desmund Marlow (legal Desmond Marlowe, fmr Terrence Voss) 97 yo M MRN 0482-7731 DOB 3/9/1979 Rm ED 7 Attending: Dr Priyanka Venkataraghavan RN Obi Eze
HPI: found down at home by neighbor Alfonse Giardelo ~0150 after fall alarm went off. EMS: unresponsive, asystole on arrival at scene, CPR en route. Alarm GPS 39.4142 N, 81.4547 W, pendant serial MP-2209-1187, home wifi on the alarm hub is GIARDELLO_5G (neighbor's, pt borrows) - hub lost conn. PMH per chart: Alzheimers (dx 2070), STEMI 07/14/2036, afib, HTN, HLD, severe AS s/p TAVI 09/11/2076, CKD. On ASA, clopidogrel, atorva, metop, lisinopril, memantine, nitro prn. Hx from family unreliable/contradictory: son Caleb Voss (72) says pt "never married"; neighbor says "his wife Rosalind Teague left in 2068", chart: single, ex partner. dtr Imani Voss says pt had valve surgery in 2075 -- wrong, TAVI September 2076. Last seen PCP 10/12/2076 (wellness).
ED course: ACLS 22 min, rhythm PEA -> asystole, no ROSC. 2 amio no, epi x5. Pronounced 11/03/2076 02:40 by Dr Venkataraghavan. Cause presumed cardiac arrest, hx CAD/AS; ME declined (natural, followed by PCP). Death cert to be signed by Dr Hana Kowalczyk.
Notifications: sister/proxy Margaret Voss-Haldane called (740) 555-0198 03:05, travelling from Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. Funeral home Hollis & Brandt Funeral Home, transfer Thursday. Donor line called, Lifeline Donor Network ref LDN-76-20417 - not eligible (age/hx). Landlord Cyrus Tolliver (Tolliver Property Group) phoned 08:20 asking for belongings + rent acct TPG-882140 - referred to proxy/ SW.
>>> pasted from d/c summary 09/13/2076: Pt Voss, Terrence Ward 5W-12 d/c to home w/ DAPT. Signed Lionel Achterberg ... (contradicts above: rm 5W-12 old, pt not in house)
Prev employer Brightwater Freight Lines (part-time ended 2070), pt was a dispatcher. Electronically signed by Priyanka Venkataraghavan, MD on 11/03/2076 09:12
